newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices boosted by low arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices boosted by low arrivals.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Monday held steady at the improved level of 1,158/1,160 rupees per quintal, dealers said.

Volumes were poor as major operators kept away ahead of the monsoon but limited arrivals helped prices to consolidate recent gains. Arrivals in the Gujarat region remained low today at 16,000/17,000 bags (75 kg each).
"Sentiment however was firm on export enquiries and traders were expecting September delivery to remain firmer in the coming days," one operator said.
Groundnut oil moved down to 352/353 rupees per 10 kg from 359/360 rupees as arrivals from the southern India improved while physical demand was at a low ebb.
"Supplies from Gujarat region however remained scattered following the commencement of rain in the Gujarat region," one miller said.
